message.jaymoskingdoms.proving_grounds.e: The altar wants %s emeralds laid beside the offering.
message.jaymoskingdoms.proving_grounds.t: The light of %s takes you up to its proving ground. Its champion is coming.
message.jaymoskingdoms.proving_grounds.w: %s's champion falls. Gather what it left: the light takes you home in %s seconds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.proving_grounds.f: You fall on the proving ground, and %s's light carries you home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.proving_grounds.l: The trial is lost. %s's light carries you home.
